Flexible (intensive) insulin therapy requires multiple 
daily injections of bolus insulin before meals in addi-
tion to basal insulin once or twice daily. Insulin can be 
adjusted to correspond to food intake, thereby mimick-
ing endogenous insulin secretion in a person without
diabetes and allowing for more ﬂ exibility regarding meal 
planning, exercise, and response to hyperglycemia.

increasing solute load. Eventually, the limit to the amount of 
solute that can be cleared is achieved and the concentration

continue up to 5–10 years before other symptoms develop), 
the body can partially adapt to the changes.
